descriptionChirho: The farthest reaches or uttermost parts of a geographical territory or region, often in the phrase 'remote parts of the north/earth'.
The back or rear section of a building or structure, especially the rear of the tabernacle or temple (opposite the entrance).
The deepest or most interior parts of an enclosed space such as a cave, pit, ship, or Sheol.
The side or flank of a person's body, used anatomically.
